plugin_dirs.value = [str(root)]
try:
    sys.settrace(tracer)
    finder = PluginFinder('extractor')
    out = list(finder.search_locations('yt_dlp_plugins.extractor'))
    sys.settrace(None)
    print('out:', out)
finally:
